panel_description_zh: 中近景平视偏俯 10 度，妻子半转身推开门，一脚已踏入门槛，一脚还在走廊；右手握白色电动牙刷，左手扶在门框上；脸是半脸（侧面 + 1/4 正面）；长直黑发低马尾、珍珠耳钉可见；表情中性，base-v1 默认态（脊背直、下巴微抬）；走廊顶灯背光，头发边缘有暖白光晕。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: MC 鲁迅
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 今天，我想用文字直播给大家看。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium close-up tilted down about 10 degrees, framed from inside the dim guest bedroom looking out at the doorway. A 30-something East Asian Chinese woman is half-turning to push the door open, one foot already across the threshold onto the bedroom floor and the other foot still in the hallway. Her right hand grips a white electric toothbrush at chest height. Her left hand rests on the door frame. Her face is shown in three-quarter view (side profile plus a quarter of the front face), visible eyes, eyebrows, and mouth contour without going to full frontal. Long straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, a single pearl stud earring visible. Expression is the neutral base-v1 default posture: spine straight, chin slightly raised, scanning the room. Fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top tucked into light grey high-waisted yoga leggings. Fluffy-cuff light grey memory-foam house slippers. Hallway ceiling light behind her casts a warm white halo on the edges of her hair. Cool blue-grey bedroom interior in foreground. Hand on the door frame shows a fresh nude-pink gel manicure (small detail, not the focus). Text watermark 'P01-PN05' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling or angry expression (this frame must stay neutral), husband figure visible in the bedroom, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, any background character
